details.description: Nova Phonecall is a variant of Deepgram's first Nova-tier speech-to-text model, tuned for telephone-call audio rather than general recordings. It shares the Nova tier's underlying architecture, which Deepgram's Model Options page describes as trained on over 100 domains and 47 billion tokens. Deepgram's Models & Languages Overview lists Nova Phonecall under "Legacy Models", meaning it has been superseded by Nova-2's phonecall-tuned variant; Nova-3 has no dedicated phonecall option, only general, medical and pharma variants.
advantages: Tuned specifically for telephone-call audio, unlike Deepgram's general-purpose Nova model.
Built on the Nova tier's architecture, which Deepgram describes as trained on over 100 domains and 47 billion tokens.
disadvantages: Deepgram's Models & Languages Overview lists Nova Phonecall under "Legacy Models", superseded by Nova-2's phonecall-tuned variant; Nova-3 has no dedicated phonecall option.
Deepgram's language documentation lists support only for English (en, en-US), narrower than the general Nova model's Spanish and Hindi support.
No word-error-rate or other accuracy figures for this model were found on Deepgram's current documentation.
use_cases: Transcribing telephone call recordings (e.g. call centers, phone-based customer service)

notes: No WER or other benchmark figures specific to Nova Phonecall were found on Deepgram's maker pages, so evaluations is left empty. The catalog carries no deprecation_date, though Deepgram's own docs mark this model legacy.
